title: Upper Deck #345 Nolan Ryan Texas Rangers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1991 Upper Deck Nolan Ryan Texas Rangers #345 trading card featuring the baseball player Nolan Ryan. It is an original vintage card from Upper Deck, measuring 3½" x 2½". The card is not autographed and is part of the baseball franchise, specifically for the Texas Rangers team. This sports trading card is a licensed reprint of the original and is from the 1991 season.
